activity.notes: Yaroslav defeated Sviatopolk at Liubech and assumed the Kyivan throne in 1016. He was driven from Kyiv in 1018, then regained the throne in 1019. ATLAS therefore records the 1016-1018 first reign as a separate Activity from the existing 1019-1054 restored reign.

sources.title: Yaroslav the Wise — Internet Encyclopedia of Ukraine
sources.citation_text: The Internet Encyclopedia of Ukraine states that Yaroslav assumed the Kyivan grand-princely title after defeating Sviatopolk, was driven from Kyiv in 1018, and regained the throne in 1019.
